name: mcp-archiveorg
description: MCP server for the Internet Archive. Search inside digitised books, browse the catalogue, and read Wayback Machine snapshots. No API key required.
long_description:
Search the text inside digitised books, newspapers and documents, browse the Internet Archive catalogue, and read Wayback Machine captures of a web page. No API key, no account.

The full-text search is what this server exists for: it reads what optical recognition took off millions of scanned pages, so it finds a phrase that appears in no title and no catalogue record.

tools.name: search_inside
tools.description: Find a phrase in the text of scanned pages.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search the catalogue by title, creator or subject.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Read one record, section by section.

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: The Wayback capture closest to a date.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: Captures of a page, oldest first.

tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Find a work, its author and its editions.
